name: Almanac X Alcron Prague
positioning: Design-led lifestyle hotel inside a restored Art Deco landmark, the former Alcron Hotel, a few steps from Wenceslas Square and the Old Town
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base near Wenceslas Square and the Old Town
Art and design lovers who want Czech artworks in the lobby and in every room
History buffs drawn to a hotel with a famous past

facts.text: The hotel is a design-led lifestyle hotel inside a restored Art Deco landmark, a few steps from Wenceslas Square and the Old Town.
The hotel was formerly the historic Alcron Hotel.
The name Alcron comes from the initial letters of founder Alois Krofta's name, with inspiration from the mythical Greek ship Alcron.
Jazz legends Louis Armstrong and Ella Fitzgerald stayed at the hotel.
The interior design is by the Spanish studio Tres Cinco Uno in collaboration with the Czech Marani Studio.
The original rare wood paneling, marble details and historic fireplace were preserved in the lobby and restaurant.
The room color palette reflects Prague: sandy tones of historic stone facades, the brick red of the Old Town's terracotta roofs, and green for the city's parks and gardens.
Almanac X Alcron Prague has been awarded One MICHELIN Key by the MICHELIN Guide.
The hotel's staircase features rotating art exhibitions.
The hotel has a sauna and a fitness center.
Studio Qubus turned the Alcron Bar into a 'Liquid Gallery', an art space filled with objects by designer Jakub Berdych Karpelis.

highlights.text: Every room and suite has unique original artworks.
A monumental mural by Czech artist Lu Skrivankova sits right behind the reception.
The Presidential Suite offers a view of Prague Castle.
The Presidential Suite is adorned with hand-cut crystal objects from the Ruckl glassworks, and a stay package adds a visit to the manufactory to try glassmaking.
On the night of August 20, 1968, an Associated Press reporter sent the world's first urgent dispatch announcing the Warsaw Pact occupation of Czechoslovakia from the hotel teletype.

considerations.text: The Alcron Rooftop terrace is not open yet; the hotel gives its planned opening as 2026.
The Alcron restaurant held a Michelin star until 2017; the hotel's current recognition is One MICHELIN Key.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
